cinematic_dialogue:2:1422624002:.text: The dragon is all your fault!

say:4:1422625001:0.text: Everyone, please be quiet. We'll take questions one by one. Let's start with you. You had a question.
say:4:1422625001:0.source_cn: 诸位，诸位，安静！请依次发言，对，从你开始，有什么问题吗？

say:5:1422625002:0.text: You said something about Captain Indris letting the dragon escape.
say:5:1422625002:0.source_cn: 我刚刚听到你质疑因度厄放走了龙？

say:6:1422625003:0.text: I-I... That's not what I meant! I just don't know what I'm supposed to do now.
say:6:1422625003:0.source_cn: 我、我没有……我只是，呃，不知道该干什么了！

say:7:1422625004:0.text: It's all his fault! If he hadn't caused this mess, I'd be working my hardest trying to get into the city!
say:7:1422625004:0.source_cn: 都怪这家伙！如果不是他搞出那么多乱七八糟的事，我还有个...

say:8:1422625005:0.text: Now that I want to go to the surface, he's here to stop me! What does he want me to do? Die here or something?!
say:8:1422625005:0.source_cn: 现在，想去地表上这家伙又不让……在这里怕不是在等死……

say:10:1422625006:0.text: Yes! And he let the dragon fly away! Doesn't that mean we won't have any Divine Dew left?
say:10:1422625006:0.source_cn: 是啊，龙飞走了。那、那岂不是很快就没有恩典灵露了。

say:11:1422625007:0.text: Without the dew, won't all of us be afflicted with corruption? We can't live without it!
say:11:1422625007:0.source_cn: 没有了恩典灵露的我们，不就孽……我们不能没有恩典灵露！

say:12:1422625008:0.text: And you, did you want to say something?
say:12:1422625008:0.source_cn: 那么这位前贵族大人，您也有话要说？

say:14:1422625009:0.text: All I know is that the situation is dire! Corruption is everywhere... more than ever before!
say:14:1422625009:0.source_cn: 我，我只知道现在这样不行！到处都是孽化，到处都……比、...

say:15:1422625010:1.text: Well, the Divine Dew is still being distributed, and order is still being maintained. I also have not received any definite reports of increasing corruption.
say:15:1422625010:1.source_cn: 现在灵露还在发放，基本秩序仍在维持。关于孽化增多的说法...

say:16:1422625011:1.text: No, listen to me, Imperator Ravion!
say:16:1422625011:1.source_cn: 不不，不是这么回事，沙利叶大人！

say:17:1422625012:1.text: Many souls have succumbed to the corruption, and it takes hold faster with each passing hour!
say:17:1422625012:1.source_cn: 周围孽化的人绝对多了，而且速度也更快了！

say:18:1422625013:1.text: The only difference between now and before is the rationing of the Divine Dew. Could the dew be the source of the corruption?
say:18:1422625013:1.source_cn: 现在跟之前唯一的区别是灵露配给制，该、该不会灵露才是孽...

say:20:1422625014:0.text: What? Then I'll throw it away! I won't drink anymore! I don't want to stay here! Let me go to the surface!
say:20:1422625014:0.source_cn: 那、那我不喝了，我要扔了它！放、放我们去地面！

say:21:1422625015:0.text: Everyone calm down. Keep your Divine Dew or the situation will get worse.
say:21:1422625015:0.source_cn: 冷静！都冷静下来！先把灵露收好，丢弃它只会让情况更糟。

say:22:1422625016:0.text: I share your concerns, truly... but in these trying times, we must stand together and not let suspicion divide us.
say:22:1422625016:0.source_cn: 听着，我理解大家的恐惧，但这种时刻更需要团结而非互相猜疑。

say:23:1422625017:0.text: The dragon's departure was inevitable, yet we need not despair. The Divine Dew shall sustain us for some time still.
say:23:1422625017:0.source_cn: 龙的离开已成定局，但灵露的储备足够支撑一段时间——

say:24:1422625018:0.text: Our reserves will sustain us through the time required for us to lift the curse.
say:24:1422625018:0.source_cn: 支撑到我们找到解除一族诅咒的办法。

say:25:1422625019:0.text: The reports of increased corruption shall be investigated without delay. I'm dispatching my most trusted inquisitors as we speak. But you must all stand firm. Unchecked hysteria will undo us faster than any plague.
say:25:1422625019:0.source_cn: 至于孽化者增多的事情，我会立即派人调查核实。保持镇定，...

say:26:1422625020:0.text: Now, please return to your duties and respective posts. I give you my word that a definitive response shall follow without delay.
say:26:1422625020:0.source_cn: 现在，请大家回到各自的岗位上，继续维持正常生活。我保证...

narration:28:140130112:0.text: The plaza is in chaos. The Essail are shouting at Indris, and he's struggling to respond. Just then, Ravion arrives and begins calming them down.
narration:28:140130112:0.source_cn: 广场上，艾塞勒们正对因度厄宣泄着不满，因度厄难以招架。...
narration:28:140130112:0.male: The plaza is in chaos. The Essail are shouting at Indris, and he's struggling to respond. Just then, Ravion arrives and begins calming them down.
narration:28:140130112:0.female: The plaza is in chaos. The Essail are shouting at Indris, and he's struggling to respond. Just then, Ravion arrives and begins calming them down.
